exams.name: Examination for proficiency and competence in nursing home administration
exams.notes: Includes a separate examination covering Vermont statutes and rules relating to nursing home administration.
exams.jurisdiction: state (administered by the Director or his or her designee)
exams.quote: the applicant has passed an examination administered by the Director or his or her designee that is designed to test for proficiency and competence and an examination covering Vermont statutes and rules relating to nursing home administration

interval_years.quote: Every holder of a nursing home administrator's license shall renew it biennially, by making application to the Director.

required.quote: The Director may by rule require that a license holder complete not more than 40 hours of approved instruction every two years as a condition of renewal.

available.quote: The Director may issue a nursing home administrator's license, without examination for proficiency and competence, to any person who holds a current license as a nursing home administrator from another jurisdiction, provided that the Director finds that the standards for licensing in the other jurisdiction are substantially equivalent to those in this State.

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a current nursing home administrator license from another jurisdiction with standards substantially equivalent to Vermont's.
requirements.quote: provided that the Director finds that the standards for licensing in the other jurisdiction are substantially equivalent to those in this State

exists.quote: The Director, with the advice of the advisors appointed under this chapter, shall have exclusive authority to determine the qualifications, skill, and fitness of any person to serve as an administrator of a nursing home

name.quote: with the advice of the advisors appointed under this chapter

authority.value: advisory only — the Director has exclusive authority; advisors provide advice
authority.quote: The Director, with the advice of the advisors appointed under this chapter, shall have exclusive authority

definition_quote.value: a person who is duly licensed by the Director and who is charged with the general administration of a nursing home whether or not the individual has an ownership interest in the home and whether or not his or her functions and duties are shared with one or more other individuals
definition_quote.quote: "Nursing home administrator" means a person who is duly licensed by the Director and who is charged with the general administration of a nursing home whether or not the individual has an ownership interest in the home and whether or not his or her functions and duties are shared with one or more other individuals.

provisional_license_available.quote: a provisional administrator may, in the discretion of the Director, be issued a provisional license to administer that home for a period not to exceed 90 days

temporary_permit_available.quote: a provisional administrator may, in the discretion of the Director, be issued a provisional license to administer that home for a period not to exceed 90 days from the date on which the regular licensed administrator first ceased to perform his or her duties.

temporary_permit_max_duration_months.quote: a provisional license to administer that home for a period not to exceed 90 days

temporary_permit_facility_restricted.quote: be issued a provisional license to administer that home

facility_type_covered.quote: "Nursing home" means any institution or facility, whether proprietary or nonproprietary, defined as a nursing home for licensing purposes pursuant to 33 V.S.A. § 7102(7)
